name: Wildcat - Z Left - 19 Sweep

TB.rule: Catch the snap and sweep left, flat and fast, behind the fullback. Turn it up outside his block.

QB.note: You are a wing on this play, not the quarterback -- you line up beside the Z, a step outside him, and you take the outside man. You do not touch the ball.

coaching_points: The snap is five yards back to the tailback, not the quarterback. Rep the snap before you rep the play -- a bad snap is the only way this loses yards.
The fullback loads the edge: he goes first, left, and takes the first man outside our end. The tailback stays behind him until the block is made.
The quarterback is a wing on this play. He does not touch the ball -- tell him before the snap, and tell the defense nothing.
